xmldoc.short_description: Bessel function of the second kind.

param_input_item.param_description: 0 (default) or 1 to return the scaled values.

param_output_item.param_description: Bessel function of the second kind.

description.p: bessely(nu, Z) computes the Bessel function of the second kind Y for each element of NU and Z. Y is infinite at Z = 0 and complex on the negative real axis.
Bessel functions are solutions of the Bessel differential equation:
bessely(nu, Z, 1) returns bessely(nu, Z) .* exp(-abs(imag(Z))).
NU and Z must have the same size, or one of them can be a scalar.
The result is single when an input is single, and real when every imaginary part is zero.
Values are computed with a C++ port of the Amos algorithms, for any real order and any complex argument.

xmldoc.bibliography: D. E. Amos, Algorithm 644: A portable package for Bessel functions of a complex argument and nonnegative order, ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software, 12 (1986), pp. 265-273.
